# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 1997

**Ordinance Granting Economic Relief Allowance to Municipal Employees**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the allocation of P12,805,247.94 for the construction and repair of government buildings in Pitogo, Quezon for the year 1998. It also grants an Economic Relief Allowance (ERA) of P1,000.00 per employee, sourced from the Human Resource Management Office budget. The ordinance specifies the allocation of funds for the ERA and outlines the effective date.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates P12,805,247.94 from the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) for the construction and repair of government buildings in Pitogo, Quezon for the year 1998.
2.  **Section 2.**  Authorizes the allocation of P39,000.00 from the budget for the grant of P1,000.00 Economic Relief Allowance (ERA) to each municipal employee.
3.  **Section 3.** The amount needed for the ERA will be charged to the Human Resource Management Office budget.
4.  **Section 4.**  The Economic Relief Allowance (ERA) will be sourced from the municipality's own funds.
5.  **Section 5.** The amount needed for the ERA for the year 1998 will be taken from the general fund.
6.  **Section 6.** This ordinance is known as the Laang-Gugulin Ordinance No. 1.
7.  **Section 7.** This ordinance takes effect on January 1, 1998.
